verdict.rationale: Codex is a coding agent explicitly designed to explore code, plan changes, edit files across a repo, run tools/tests, and produce diffs/PRs from natural-language prompts, per official docs and GitHub description. Community evidence corroborates real-world multi-file feature/bug implementation (e.g., 'edits the files and I can use the proper tooling to adjust and test stuff', comparable to an engineer), though some users report inconsistent quality/UX. Missing for 10: no controlled first-party benchmark demonstrating cross-file bug-fix success rate, and some community reports of struggling with tasks temper full confidence.
